# Plot of ERPS
```{r}
library(tidytable)
library(ggplot2)

setwd("paper")
```

## load data
```{r}
erp_df <- read.csv("data/erp_lp.csv") |>
    mutate(
        lp_quantile = factor(lp_quantile,
            levels = c("low_lp", "med_lp", "high_lp")
        )
    )
```

## plot function
```{r}
erp_plot <- function(
    df,
    reading_cond,
    channels = c("all"),
    content_words = FALSE,
    annotate_timewindow = FALSE) {
    # filter channels
    if (channels[1] == "all" && length(channels) == 1) {
        df <- df |>
            filter(!.key %in% c("HEOG", "VEOG", "M1", "M2"))
    } else {
        df <- df |>
            filter(.key %in% channels)
    }

    # specify value col
    if (content_words) {
        df <- df |>
            mutate("value" = .value_content_words)
    } else {
        df <- df |>
            mutate("value" = .value)
    }

    p <- df |>
        filter(reading_type == reading_cond) |>
        ggplot(aes(x = .time, y = value)) +
        stat_summary(
            fun = "mean", geom = "line", alpha = 1, linewidth = 1,
            aes(color = lp_quantile)
        ) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        eeguana::theme_eeguana() +
        theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
        labs(color = "", y = "") +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("steelblue1", "steelblue3", "steelblue4"))

    if (!isFALSE(annotate_timewindow)) {
        p <- p + annotate("rect",
            xmin = annotate_timewindow[1], xmax = annotate_timewindow[2],
            ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
            alpha = .1, fill = "slategray4"
        )
    }

    return(p)
}
```

## Plots
```{r}
n400_chs <- c(
    "Cz", "Pz", "C4", "CP6", "P4", "P3",
    "CP5", "C3", "P8", "PO3", "PO4", "P7"
)
p600_chs <- c(
    "Cz", "CP2", "Pz", "CP1", "C4", "CP6",
    "P4", "P3", "CP5", "C3", "T8", "TP8",
    "P8", "PO3", "PO4", "P7", "TP7", "T7"
)

n400_timewindow <- c(.3, .5)
p600_timewindow <- c(.5, .7)
```

```{r}
erp_plot(
    df = erp_df,
    reading_cond = "SPR",
    channels = p600_chs,
    content_words = FALSE,
    annotate_timewindow = p600_timewindow
)
```
